hypothesis: Explicit single-precision reciprocal square root plus an inverse-distance-cubed scale can replace sqrt-and-divide work in each interaction. Accumulating acceleration directly cancels the target-mass multiply/divide while retaining one thread per target, source traversal, self-pair handling, update order, softening, and exact mass copying.
notes: The baseline is valid with three timing samples averaging 0.0018526411283622502 seconds; no candidate measurements are available, so no speed or correctness claim is made. The controller should check numerical tolerances, nonfinite outputs, and the extreme-mass case before timing. That supplied extreme-mass case has n=1, so the unchanged self-pair skip prevents an interaction there; it does not independently test cancellation on an interacting extreme-mass target.
transformations: Replace sqrtf and division by explicit rsqrtf(distSq) and a product forming the inverse-distance cubed.
Cancel the target-mass multiply/divide algebraically by accumulating source-mass-weighted acceleration directly.

Preserve float32 softening, the self-pair skip, per-target source loop, velocity-before-position update order, and Particle mass copying; do not change launch configuration or enable global fast math.
